product_metadata.title: Whitmor 3 Pair Boot Rack - Adjustable Heavy Duty Frame - White 10.25 x 22.25 x 17.25
features: 3 pair shoe and boot organizer helps keep your closet floor uncluttered
Adjustable spacing feature to accommodate different size boots
Promotes air circulation, allowing boots to breathe
Prevents boots from folding over and keeps boots fresh and in good shape
Multiple units work great together for added space
description: Whitmor Boot rack in white color offers convenient storage of 3 pairs of shoes in an orderly manner. Whitmor Boot rack can be fitted in the closets or anywhere in the home. 10.25 x 17.5 x 22.5 Rack in white color can be slide up and down for placing the boots easily. Material: Resin. Holds three pairs of boots. Dimension: 17.5(H) x 22.5(W) x 10.3(L). Assembly required. Application/usage: Boot. Perfect for closets or anywhere in the home. Neatly organizes boots.
